notes: SPOTLIGHT SOLO v2 MACRO BOOTS (No.10 boots and shins at macro x4, side view, facing east; StrikeMacro convention). No numbers: may be mirrored in code (MB3 mirrored = the LEFT boot; no west strip needed). turf = row 109 (MB1's studs sink 2 px under it), scale = 4 (the brief's "xN" is figure-equivalent: draw scale = N/4, x4 = 1.0, x5 = 1.25 nearest), ballR = 23 = the canonical macro ball (a turf ball centre on row 86). pelvis = laces (the default anchor; contact null); place with any named anchor: boot = the contact point of the touching surface (MB1 ball of the planted foot, MB2 toe = boot, MB3 the inside face, MB4 the outside of the forefoot, MB5 the arch, MB6 the sole = boot), toe, heel, ankle, knee (may lie outside the canvas: the shin leaves the top edge on purpose), soleMid, ballPt = where the ball meets the boot. ball = the r 23 ball centre (never drawn); ballDir = the unit vector from the contact to the ball centre (a bigger hero ball slides its centre along it); ballUnder: false = draw the ball OVER the sprite (MB1, MB4, MB5), true = under. Points are pixel indices (studioAnim adds 0.5). Uses: MB1 4 / 0.00 (x5, then the far planted boot at 70 %); MB2 4 / 0.10-0.21 (x5), 8a / 0.80 black silhouette; MB3 4 / 0.40, 0.60 (x5; mirrored 0.50, 0.70), 7a / 0.00, 1.00 (x4; mirrored 0.20), 8b / 1.00, 1.40 (x4; mirrored 1.20); MB4 7a / 0.40-0.767 (x4); MB5 7a / 0.80-1.00 (x4; a 2-frame smear at 0.767); MB6 3 / 1.00-1.20 (x5, the ball 108 px under the sole), 8b / 1.50-1.60 (x4). Studio: Sochetra / MacroBoots / Side, layer Art (Front/Back blank).
